images.alt_en: How the genitive reveals the stem of a third-declension noun, with the endings -ος, -ι, -α, -ες, -ων, -σι, -ας attached

images.alt_grc: οὗτος ὁ παῖς · ἐκεῖνος ὁ ἀνήρ
images.alt_en: Near and far: οὗτος for what is close to the speaker, ἐκεῖνος for what is far away; the article stands between demonstrative and noun
Active endings -ω -εις -ει -ομεν -ετε -ουσι beside middle endings -ομαι -ει/-ῃ -εται -όμεθα -εσθε -ονται
A hill with arrows: πρός towards, ἀπό away from, ἐπί on, μετά with; the case each takes written beside it
